records.prompt:
Edit the provided membership banner into a NORMAL STANDARD 16:9 horizontal luxury membership card banner, similar to 1536x864. Use the same overall design direction as the approved VIP8 sample: premium private-club identity card, deep black lacquer background, ornate right-side emblem/crest area, elegant border, rich metal highlights, and a small integrated VIP level mark in the TOP-LEFT corner.

The VIP mark must be small and restrained, like an embossed/foil membership level corner badge, not a giant title. It must feel native to the card surface, not pasted on. Keep lower-left and center-left dark and clean enough for native app text overlays.

Strict constraints: no chip, no card number, no QR code, no barcode, no payment card elements, no logo, no watermark, no Chinese characters, no extra text besides the exact VIP mark. Avoid ultra-wide/panoramic layout, avoid square crop, avoid giant VIP text.

Tier: normal / entry private-club membership tier.
Tier-specific visual style: black pearl and soft silver, elegant restrained silver-white foil, subtle pearl ornament, less ornate than higher tiers.
Exact visible text requirement: the top-left badge must read exactly VIP1, no spaces, no punctuation, no other letters or numbers.
Gold/metal brightness: make the metallic accents bright and eye-catching like polished foil, but refined and not cheap. For non-gold tiers, keep the tier color identity while using crisp luminous metallic highlights.
